integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo standard one-place Artin–Schreier valuation theory and the source family identification. Finite verification is corroborative, not a proof for all parameters. Prior maximality, trivial-automorphism and p-gonality results are credited to their original authors.
scientific_limitations: Geometric Weierstrass semigroup only at the unique point above u=infinity, for odd primes p and n>=2. No all-points semigroup, integral code-distance, or exhaustive literature-priority assertion. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Complete infinity semigroups on maximal curves without geometric automorphisms
